name: ArtBench-10
description: We introduce ArtBench-10, the first class-balanced, high-quality, cleanly annotated, and standardized dataset for benchmarking artwork generation. It comprises 60,000 images of artwork from 10 distinctive artistic styles, with 5,000 training images and 1,000 testing images per style. ArtBench-10 has several advantages over previous artwork datasets. Firstly, it is class-balanced while most previous artwork datasets suffer from the long tail class distributions. Secondly, the images are of high quality with clean annotations. Thirdly, ArtBench-10 is created with standardized data collection, annotation, filtering, and preprocessing procedures. We provide three versions of the dataset with different resolutions ($32\times32$, $256\times256$, and original image size), formatted in a way that is easy to be incorporated by popular machine learning frameworks. We also conduct extensive benchmarking experiments using representative image synthesis models with ArtBench-10 and present in-depth analysis. The dataset is available at https://github.com/liaopeiyuan/artbench under a Fair Use license.
evaluation_method: FID (Fréchet Inception Distance) and human evaluation (quality/style fidelity); IS sometimes reported
reputation: An introduced (2022) balanced and clean artwork dataset that has seen adoption in generative‑modeling research as a standardized style benchmark, but is not yet universally used.
notes: Class-balanced and high-quality but modest per-class training size (5,000 images); licensed under Fair Use — potential copyright/ethical considerations; evaluations can vary strongly with resolution and model capacity; not an LLM/text benchmark.
